profile.description_en: Hamilton STAR automated liquid handling platform for laboratory aspiration, dispensing, tip handling, liquid level detection, plate and carrier transport, with control of iSWAP, the CoRe 96 head, autoload carrier handling, and some connected heating/cooling modules.
